authorization: 2026-10-24 user explicitly requested archive HGC, matched Risk-LR increment test, whole unseen chains, and bounded neural resource/real-chain validation.
data_scope: Already-exposed official VAL; new whole update realizations, not unseen texts. TEST/OOS never model inputs.
basis_contract: Same fixed 40% TRAIN basis per seed; may include TRAIN rows outside a refresh slot. Never VAL/TEST. Different architecture-specific tokenization.
refresh_contract: Stratify TRAIN by label; order by SHA256(pilot-train-v1|seed|sample_id), ID tie; array_split into five blocks; f0/f1/f2/f3 exclude block0/1/2/3, respectively. About80% TRAIN each; natural incoming/outgoing data, no label corruption.

predictor.selection: leave-one-whole-development-chain-out macro average precision; smallest C breaks ties
predictor.scaler: weighted StandardScaler fit on training folds only
predictor.weights: each chain total1, positives/negatives each .5 if both present; missing class chain uniform total1

decision_policy.replication: Both architectures pass in the same registered update condition. One architecture only is exploratory conditional signal, not GO.
decision_policy.no_increment: NO_DETECTED_STABLE_INCREMENT and stop pursuing historical-risk new algorithms in tested setting

cost_policy.scope: text normalize/encode/transform and model probability inference, warm cache; fixed four deterministic primary suites; selection plus shared historical feature construction shown separately; no claimed deployment savings

freeze_policy: Freeze all twelve heldout chains, models, predictors, histories, scores, pool IDs/gold, and all 1152 suites before ANY heldout-VAL target inference; up to32 TRAIN rows are allowed only for save/restore validation. Neural development targets may only fit development predictors.
limits: 3 related seeds per architecture/update condition; descriptive screening, not significance or universal null.
Only one dataset and one small non-pretrained neural architecture.
Risk-LR is an adapted diagnostic tool, not the complete original reproduction or a novel algorithm.
No HGC parameter/feature/objective tuning and no automatic extra chains after results.
